note: Issue #97 (Generations free vacation, EaVacation.cs, docs/210): vacexport, vacstoreguard, vacreturnskip, vacteendelete, vacexitreturn, vaclistenernull, vacimportfix, all default off. Built 2026-10-30, never run. Correctness and save matrix only, no timing: day run, stop on any FAIL, crash or ScriptError from our hooks (triage against the change ledger first). The off arms reproduce EA's defects on purpose: bp-vacation-orphan's off arm expects one NullReferenceException ScriptError (Motives.CreateMotives from Sim.OnCreation), bp-vacation-teendelete's off arm may log one; any other ScriptError is a fail. Precondition every job: the active household has a teen and an adult in the world (VacationCheck maketeen ages a child up if needed; if it answers 'no teen and no child', switch the job to a save that has one: not a fail of the fixes). Jobs 1-4 = per-defect off/on in one load (on first where the off arm loses Sims), 5-6 = save matrix on two worlds (save during the pickup, new, overwrite x2, back-to-back, unpaused, reload + play x2, save after reload). The save-matrix.ts identical case does not apply: a trip in progress changes save data by design (EA's own travel fields); our own state is never saved. After job 5 load Vacation-BP-5 once by hand (reload case: household intact, no new ErrorTrap reset).
